Cost Per Dose: 100eb (Premium)

A military combat drug that inhibits pain receptors. A favorite of junkies that realized it can give you a full day of no aches or pains. You’ll lose 24 hours to brain fog, but isn’t that worth it for freedom?

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 24 hours.
  • Users without a Cyberspine must succeed a DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs Check or else suffer the effect (but not the Bonus Damage) of the Spinal Injury Critical Injury for the duration of the Primary Effect.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, when the user suffers a Critical Injury, they do not take any Bonus Damage.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, any penalties the user suffers to STATs or Action-related Checks from Critical Injuries are halved. This does not eliminate other effects such as increasing Death Save Penalty, the inability to perform a task, and so on.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, Medtechs that attempt a Treatment on the user gain a +1 bonus to their Surgery Check.
  • Users become extremely tired and disoriented. Do your best to roleplay accordingly.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • The user is unable to recall information and events they experienced during their exposure to Blue Butter’s Primary Effect.
  • If the user is currently addicted to Berserker or Black Lace, they suffer 1d6 Humanity Loss.
  • If the user wasn’t already addicted to Blue Butter, they are now. While addicted, unless the user is currently experiencing Blue Butter’s Primary Effect, their INT and COOL are reduced by 2.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "Blue Butter Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "Blue Butter Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
